description: Distinguishes molecular solutions from colloidal dispersions and explains Brownian motion, settling, electrostatic and steric stabilization, and emulsion failure by creaming, flocculation, coalescence or Ostwald ripening. Connects particle sizing and interfacial coverage to milk, mayonnaise and paint.
